title: Fix blurry logo and add correct phone support contact

requirements.text: Replace the placeholder support phone number in the in-app Support UI with the user-provided phone support contact: +254 723169783, and ensure it is rendered as a tappable/clickable tel: link.
acceptanceCriteria: Opening the Support UI shows a "Phone Support" entry with the exact number "+254 723169783".
Clicking/tapping the phone number uses a tel: link that initiates a call to +254 723169783 on supported devices/browsers.

requirements.text: Ensure a visible "Customer Support" contact list exists in the Support UI (Support drawer) and is accessible from both the header "Support" entry and the footer "Customer Support" entry.

quotes: the contact list impossed hasnt been create.

acceptanceCriteria: From the header "Support" button, the Support drawer opens and displays the support contacts list.
From the footer "Customer Support" button, the Support drawer opens and displays the support contacts list.
The Support drawer contains at least one contact item labeled in English (e.g., "Phone Support") and includes +254 723169783.

requirements.text: Fix the Genz App logo clarity so it looks sharp when rendered as a 40x40 rounded icon in the header while keeping the asset path `/assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png`.
acceptanceCriteria: When displayed in the header at 40x40 with rounded corners, the logo appears crisp (not blurry/pixelated) at normal zoom and on high-DPI screens.
No code changes alter the logo image path used by `frontend/src/components/Header.tsx` (it must continue to reference `/assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png`).

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn UI sources are read-only).
Do not edit immutable hook/provider files: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx.
All user-facing text must be in English.
Keep the logo asset path exactly `/assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png`.
nonGoals: Adding additional support channels (WhatsApp/SMS/social links) unless explicitly provided by the user.
Backend changes for support contacts (store contacts in Motoko) are out of scope for this request.

edits: Improve sharpness/clarity and legibility of the existing logo (genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png > genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png)
